development.title: Multicenter external validation of CT-based deep learning for proximal femoral fracture classification
development.evidence: CT-based deep learning system for classification and fracture-line angle measurement, evaluated across hospitals and in a preliminary reader study. This evidence card does not contain verified sample sizes or performance estimates. Online ahead of print.

development.title: Digital-health fracture liaison service continuation in a citywide multihospital registry
development.evidence: Retrospective citywide cohort of 9,211 patients; 8,691 in the 90-day landmark analysis. Surgery at the FLS-designated hospital was associated with lower hazard of a later different-site fracture requiring surgery, adjusted HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.44–0.84). No evidence of reduced all-cause mortality. Exposure was hospital-level and residual confounding and surgery-only ascertainment limit inference.

development.title: Enhancing return to daily life activities after total and unicompartmental knee arthroplasty with a personalized eHealth program (ACTIVE)
development.evidence: Multicentre randomized controlled trial of personalized perioperative eHealth guidance after knee arthroplasty. Sample size and effect estimates are not confirmed in this evidence card.

development.title: Development and external validation of machine learning to classify ACL reconstruction status
development.evidence: Classifies past reconstruction status, does not predict surgical benefit or return to sport. PubMed issue date October 2026, exact first publication day unverified. Use as an older distractor.
